'''2007 Yavin 4 Regionals Greg Shaw DS Endor: Forest Clearing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2007 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor: Forest Clearing|Endor-D-endorforestclearing.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Crumbercules? I Love That Guy
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
